dilapidated.label: Dilapidated other-vacancy rate
dilapidated.definition: Dwellings classified as dilapidated “other vacant” as a share of all dwellings in 2023.
dilapidated.source: 2023 Housing and Land Survey, tables 34-2 and 1-2-1

vacancy.label: Total vacancy rate
vacancy.definition: All vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings in 2023.
vacancy.source: 2023 Housing and Land Survey, tables 34-2 and 1-2-1
vacancy.note: Includes rental, sale, secondary, and other vacant dwellings.

dilapidated_change.label: Change in dilapidated other-vacancy rate
dilapidated_change.definition: Change in the dilapidated “other vacant” share of dwellings between 2018 and 2023, in percentage points.

population_change.label: Population change, 2020–2025
population_change.definition: Change in municipal population between the 2020 and 2025 Censuses.

fiscal.label: Fiscal strength index
fiscal.definition: Municipal fiscal strength index for FY2022. Higher values indicate stronger own-source fiscal capacity.
fiscal.note: The 23 special wards have no municipal fiscal-strength index.

station_density.label: Heavy-rail station density
station_density.definition: Heavy-rail stations per 100 square kilometres in 2023. Tram stops are excluded.
station_density.note: 126 municipalities have no heavy-rail station. That is a measured zero, not missing data.

sources: Housing and Land Survey 2023, Statistics Bureau of Japan
